title: Cloud sync
aboutHint: Oleafly keeps a copy of your Library projects and settings in your own {{provider}}, so you can pick up where you left off on another computer. It syncs while Oleafly is open.
lead: Back up your Library projects to your own cloud storage and open them on your other computers.
syncsProjects: Projects in your Library and their files. Build output, the .git folder and Oleafly's own working folders are left out.
syncsSettings: Your settings, including AI instructions, personas and your custom dictionary.
syncsNotYet: Git history and checkpoints don't sync yet.
syncNever: AI chats, passwords and keys never leave this computer.

providerHint.dropbox: Sign in with your Dropbox account.
providerHint.google_drive: Sign in with your Google account.
providerHint.s3: Use a bucket on Amazon S3, MinIO or a similar service.

pasteInstead: Trouble signing in? Paste a code instead
pasteHint: {{provider}} will show a code. Copy it and paste it here.
pastePreparing: Opening a new sign-in page in your browser
loadFailed: Couldn't load cloud sync. Try again.
syncOnHelp: Syncs while Oleafly is open. Turning this off stops syncing here only. Your other computers and your {{provider}} don't change.

auto.label: Sync automatically
auto.description: Oleafly syncs a few seconds after you save and soon after another computer changes your {{provider}}. Turn this off to sync only when you click Sync now.

computer.label: Computer name
computer.description: Your other computers show this name, for example on a copy of a change you made here.

revoked: {{provider}} access ended. Connect again to keep syncing.
quotaFull: Your {{provider}} is full. New changes stay on this computer until there's space. To make room, turn off sync for large projects or remove them from {{provider}}.

disconnectRow.label: Disconnect {{provider}}
disconnectRow.description: Stops syncing on this computer and removes Oleafly's access to your {{provider}}. Nothing is deleted, here or in {{provider}}.

settingsUnreadable: Oleafly can't read the settings in your {{provider}}. They won't sync until you replace them.

projects.title: Projects
projects.off: Sync is off on this computer
projects.offline: Couldn't reach {{provider}}. Oleafly will try again.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Projects you create in your Library will sync.
projects.checkFailed: Couldn't load the projects in your {{provider}}.
projects.linkedNote_one: {{count}} project opened from a folder isn't synced. Only projects in your Library are backed up.
projects.linkedNote_other: {{count}} projects opened from a folder aren't synced. Only projects in your Library are backed up.

row.conflictsHelp_one: This file changed here and on another computer before they synced, so Oleafly kept both. Keep what you need, then delete the copy.
row.conflictsHelp_other: These files changed here and on another computer before they synced, so Oleafly kept both. Keep what you need, then delete the copies.
row.heldMessage_one: {{count}} of {{total}} files was deleted here, so sync is paused to keep the copy in your {{provider}} safe.
row.heldMessage_other: {{count}} of {{total}} files were deleted here, so sync is paused to keep the copy in your {{provider}} safe.
row.heldRemoteMessage_one: {{count}} of {{total}} files is missing from your {{provider}}, so sync is paused to keep it safe on this computer.
row.heldRemoteMessage_other: {{count}} of {{total}} files are missing from your {{provider}}, so sync is paused to keep them safe on this computer.

skipReason.unsupportedName: Name that doesn't work on every computer
skipReason.duplicateName: Same name as another file apart from capitals

confirm.removeDescription: This deletes the copy in your {{provider}} to free up space. The project stays on this computer and stops syncing here. Your other computers keep their copies and stop syncing it too.
confirm.removeRemoteDescription: This deletes the project from your {{provider}} to free up space. It isn't on this computer, so you can't download it here afterwards. Computers that already have it keep their copies and stop syncing it.
confirm.replaceDescription: Oleafly can't read the copy in your {{provider}}. It will be replaced with the copy on this computer, and anything that's only in {{provider}} will be lost.
confirm.deleteDescription_one: The file you deleted from {{name}} on this computer will also be deleted from your {{provider}}. Other computers that sync this project will lose it too.
confirm.deleteDescription_other: The {{count}} files you deleted from {{name}} on this computer will also be deleted from your {{provider}}. Other computers that sync this project will lose them too.
confirm.deleteHereTitle: Delete these files on this computer too?
confirm.deleteHereDescription_one: The file missing from your {{provider}} goes to this computer's trash, so {{name}} matches your other computers.
confirm.deleteHereDescription_other: The {{count}} files missing from your {{provider}} go to this computer's trash, so {{name}} matches your other computers.
confirm.disconnectDescription: Syncing stops on this computer. Your projects stay on this computer and in your {{provider}}.

choice.title: Which settings should Oleafly use?
choice.description: Your {{provider}} has settings from another computer, and they're different from the ones here. Pick the set you want. Your other computers will use it too.

toast.restored: {{name}} is back from the Recycle Bin.
toast.removed: {{name}} was removed from your {{provider}}. It's still on this computer.
toast.replaced: {{name}} in your {{provider}} now matches this computer.
toast.filesRestored: The deleted files are back in {{name}}.
toast.filesDeleted: The deleted files were removed from your {{provider}} too.
toast.filesUploadedAgain: The files from {{name}} are back in your {{provider}}.
toast.filesDeletedHere: The files were moved to this computer's trash.

accessNotRevoked.dropbox: Disconnected. Oleafly couldn't reach Dropbox to end its access. To end it yourself, remove Oleafly under Connected apps in your Dropbox settings.
accessNotRevoked.google_drive: Disconnected. Oleafly couldn't reach Google to end its access. To end it yourself, remove Oleafly under Third-party apps & services in your Google Account.
accessNotRevoked.s3: Disconnected. The access key still works until you delete it at your storage service.

s3.title: Connect S3-compatible storage
s3.hint: Works with Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage with HMAC keys, MinIO and other services that support conditional writes.
s3.endpointInvalid: Enter a URL that starts with https:// or http://.
s3.pathStyleHint: MinIO and most self-hosted servers need this.

errors.clock_skew: This computer's clock is off, so {{provider}} won't accept requests from it. Set the correct date and time to keep syncing.
errors.code_invalid: That code didn't work. Try again.
errors.device_name_invalid: A computer name can't contain \ / : * ? " < > | or control characters, and it can be at most 32 characters long.
errors.disabled: Sync is turned off on this computer.
errors.disk_full: This computer is running out of disk space. Free up some space to keep syncing.
errors.download_missing: Some files of this project are missing from {{provider}}, so it wasn't downloaded.
errors.local_io: Oleafly couldn't read or write a file in this project. It will try again on the next sync.
errors.newer_version: This project was synced by a newer version of Oleafly. Update Oleafly to keep syncing it.
errors.not_found: This project is no longer in your {{provider}}.
errors.project_busy: This project was in use, so it will sync next time.
errors.quota_full: Your {{provider}} is full. New changes stay on this computer until there's space.
errors.rate_limited: {{provider}} asked Oleafly to slow down. Sync will try again shortly.
errors.remote_busy: Another computer was syncing this project at the same time. It will sync again shortly.
errors.remote_unreadable: Oleafly can't read the copy in your {{provider}}, so this project isn't syncing.
errors.s3_bucket: Oleafly couldn't open that bucket. Check the name, and check that these keys can read and write to it.
errors.s3_credentials: The service didn't accept those keys. Check the access key ID and secret access key.
errors.s3_endpoint: Oleafly couldn't reach that endpoint. Check the URL and your connection.
errors.s3_no_conditional_writes: This service doesn't support conditional writes. Sync needs them so two computers syncing at once can't overwrite each other's changes. Amazon S3, Google Cloud Storage and MinIO support them.
errors.server: {{provider}} had a problem. Sync will try again shortly.
errors.sign_in_timeout: Sign-in took too long. Try again.
errors.too_many_files: This project has more than 100,000 files. That's too many to sync.
errors.traffic_limit: Your {{provider}} has reached its upload limit. New changes stay on this computer until {{provider}} allows uploads again.
errors.verify_failed: A file from {{provider}} didn't match what Oleafly expected, so it was left alone. Sync will try again.
